title: Chemically tailored lipids mediate solid-phase RNA programming of mineralized microenvironments.
snippet: The localized delivery of RNA therapeutics to mineralized tissue interfaces is limited by poor retention and rapid clearance at the target site. We report the development of a solid-phase transfection platform that functionalizes mineralized surfaces into bioactive nucleic acid reservoirs.
